name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Urban Local Body In Providing Services And Facilities To Senior Citizens
briefDescription: This central scheme awards municipal bodies for outstanding work in providing services and facilities to senior citizens. Awards are conferred annually on October 1st.
descriptionMd:
The National Award for Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman) recognizes outstanding work by urban local bodies.
It aims to appreciate and encourage municipal bodies that excel in providing services and facilities tailored for senior citizens. This initiative highlights exemplary contributions towards improving the lives of the elderly within urban areas.
benefitsMd:
*   Recognition as 'Best Urban Local Body' for services to senior citizens.
*   Conferment of the prestigious award by the Hon’ble President of India.
*   Awards ceremony held annually on October 1st at Vigyan Bhawan, Delhi.
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be an urban local body or municipal body.
*   Must have demonstrated outstanding work in providing services and facilities to senior citizens.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
